ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.
